title: Speaking — Public notices
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on public notices.

questions: What part of your work or study do you look forward to?
When do you usually find it easiest to focus?
What would make your workplace or classroom more comfortable?
Do you expect to do something different in future?
Which notices do you pay attention to when you go out?
Do messages on public transport usually catch your eye?

part2.topic: Describe a public notice that led you to discover something useful.
points: what you did with the information
part2.closing: and explain why the notice was effective.

questions: What are the characteristics of a public notice that people will actually read?
What are the advantages of using several languages on public signs?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to public notices?
